# data/external

Third-party data, as delivered. Raw DB dumps under `dumps/` (create as needed).

Keep this index current; large files get a `<file>.md` sidecar. See [../README.md](../README.md).

## Datasets

- `driving-clips/idle-3s.mp4` - 3 s idle driving clip for LivePortrait (blinks, slight smile), cut from `liveportrait/d9.mp4` frames 372-461; 512x480, 30 fps, 90 frames; MIT; sidecar `idle-3s.md`
- `driving-clips/liveportrait/d0.mp4` - LivePortrait bundled driving example (`assets/examples/driving/d0.mp4`, MIT); 512x512, 25 fps, 78 frames
